summary:
Bundle bndl-3cbe8ce109eb9547 (10:00-10:08Z on 2026-11-14, 31 events) does not support an incident. No log removal, data staging, or policy-violating transfer was established.

Supported observations: two 6.4 MB flows from gateway 192.0.2.30 at 10:03:20-22Z went to 198.51.100.16:443 and 198.51.100.28:443. Both are approved destinations (review and archive stores). They exceed the 5 MB bulk threshold but are policy-consistent. Records logged svc-delivery queue_report entries of 6400000 bytes at 10:03:10 and 10:03:11Z. The link between those reports and the flows is inferred from timing and byte counts only.

Log integrity: records access.log (forwarded) matches its collector copy line-for-line (8 vs 8), so no removal is indicated. Records auth.log has no collector copy under the logging policy, so removal cannot be assessed either way.

Attribution: accounts svc-delivery and svc-ingest were used. No human operator is established.

Downgraded: the retention-explained-absence finding (no absence exists) and the auth.log collection-gap finding (coverage unknown, not a demonstrated gap).
